description: §17.1.1 (S482) — a `//` comment and a `#{}` style block between an `if=` member and its `else` do not break the chain: the program compiles (no E-CTRL-001) and the `else` member renders while the flag is false.
rationale: §17.1.1 (S482): "Nor SHALL a `//` comment or a `#{ }` style block (§9.1) between chain members break a chain, for the same reason: neither has content or behaviour where it stands." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S481-nested-init-chain-comments item 2 — "neither breaks the chain. Neither has content or behaviour, the same reason S471 gave for HTML comments. This accepts more programs." (owner: "aprove both, lets wrap").
